title: Wind Rain Snow A-Z
hook: Wind, liquid, ice: sort the texture before the word.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D mixed-weather storybook, wind swirls rain drops and snow shapes kept simple, strong isolated foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting weather phenomena by physical texture and response
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reset the three texture families while allowing nonmembers to stay context
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written physical-category lines; instruments and clothing are context
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: texture cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe abstract gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Organize the song by three physical textures—wind movement, liquid rain, frozen precipitation—while instruments and clothing become responses or observers rather than being shoved into one rhythm family.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Whoosh, tap, hush are compositional colors, not fake sound effects for every target; transitions explain whether a target is wind, water, ice, gear, or measurement.
